title: Secret Bundle Compiler
description: Compiles Kubernetes secret manifests (SealedSecrets, ExternalSecrets). Enforces: no plaintext secret values in tracked files, every key maps to a declared env variable, target namespace unique per environment, all secret manager path refs are syntactically valid.

error_codes.SB001: secret-bundle-spec.json missing or invalid — required: secrets[], namespace, environments[]
error_codes.SB002: Secret key not mapped to a declared env variable
error_codes.SB003: Duplicate namespace+environment combination — secret names must be unique per env
error_codes.SB004: Plaintext secret value found in tracked manifest file
error_codes.SB005: Secret manager path reference has invalid syntax
